note: 捕猎者，熟悉猎物能力；请玩家提供仙人掌；直白利落；热衷改良捕猎工具；收益只是期望，不保证提高掉落。

messages.raw: §fI've been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so I can hunt them more efficiently. I really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!
messages.text: I've been planning to build a trap for unaware animals so I can hunt them more efficiently. I really need some cactus, preferably the ones with the biggest spikes!
messages.zh: 我打算做个陷阱,趁动物没防备时逮住它们,打猎也能省点事。正缺些仙人掌,最好挑刺最大的!

messages.raw: §fAmazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my Cactus Trap...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.
messages.text: Amazing! Thanks for taking the time! Now, time to finish my Cactus Trap...and hopefully it boosts my pelt earnings.
messages.zh: 太好了! 谢谢你专门跑这一趟! 该去把我的仙人掌陷阱做完了……希望能多赚点毛皮。

messages.text: You can't tell me that you couldn't find a single cactus...
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 你可别告诉我,你连一株仙人掌都找不到……

source_note: 拒绝台词于 2026-09-12 以新版社区 Wiki Dialogue 表补齐，并由 Fandom 历史档案交叉核对；现有其他台词保留游戏内实测状态。
